titre: Les populations à équiper dans le monde
sous_titre: Millions de personnes, estimation 2024 et projection 2050

Diabète, 65 à 99 ans.texte: the estimated number of people with diabetes aged 65-99 years was 158.3 million (23.7%)

Intolérance au glucose.texte: An estimated 635 million adults aged 20-79 years are living with impaired glucose tolerance (12%)

Hyperglycémie à jeun.texte: an estimated 487.7 million adults or 9.2% of the global adult population were estimated to have impaired fasting glucose
